verdict.rationale: CoreWeave documents Capacity Finder in the Cloud Console, which lets you compare placement availability across Zones for a requested instance type and Node count before creating a node pool, directly addressing checking availability before provisioning. However, it is only described in the Spot Node Pool docs as a single brief mention; the quotas page covers quota errors rather than physical availability. Missing for 10: evidence that availability is real-time, coverage of on-demand or reserved capacity beyond Spot, programmatic or API access to availability data, detailed docs on what Capacity Finder shows, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
